name: agent-scheduler
description: Start coding agents on a schedule: a tracked schedule file says which command runs when and how many at once; the scheduler pulls the project's agent-data branch, checks, and asks agent-runner to run one agent per due command; and it brings the Scheduler section of the dashboard's Settings page, the Scheduler card of its Overview and the stop line on its usage bar.

scripts.build: pnpm -C ../agent-data build && pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver/core build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver/claude build && pnpm -C ../agent-runner build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build -c dashboard/vite.config.ts
scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C ../agent-data build && pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver/core build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver/claude build && pnpm -C ../agent-runner build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p dashboard/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=60000 'dist-test/**/*.test.js' && cd dashboard && vitest run
